method: Direct requests with the project UA (a few per county, no crawling; robots not consulted for single fetches), WebSearch for discovery, WebFetch for aggregator pages. Downloads were kept in the session scratchpad only. No challenge or block was bypassed.

schema.county_slug: Short stable slug. Reuses the repo's existing slugs ('sb', 'smc'); new ones are short lowercase tokens.
schema.covered: true when CalBallot already loads this county's November 3, 2026 measures.
schema.registrar_name: Office that runs the county's elections.
schema.measure_list: Object. urls: [{url, format, role, access, checked_at, http_status, final_url, last_modified, notes}]; includes_question_text, includes_thresholds, includes_jurisdiction: true/false/'partial'/'unknown'; measure_count: integer or null; count_method: how the number was counted; letters: measure letters as listed (when read).
schema.documents: Object. hosts: [{host, role, example_url, access, pdf_text, notes}]; pdf_text is 'text', 'scanned', 'mixed' or 'unknown', from sampling the example. county_hosts_all_documents: true/false/'unknown'.
schema.results: Object. urls: [{url, format, access, ...}]; formats: list (html, pdf, csv, xlsx, json, precinct_pdf, precinct_csv, spa); precinct_level: true/false/'unknown'; status_label: label shown on the page, verbatim; last_updated_shown: timestamp text verbatim as shown; multi_county_marking: how the page marks a measure shared with other counties.
schema.access: Summary: 'ok' when every needed URL answered 200 to the project UA; otherwise 'blocked_403', 'bot_challenge', 'empty_202' or 'partial', with blocked_urls. Never bypassed.
schema.checked_at: UTC ISO timestamp of the last request made for this county.
schema.cross_checks: Object of aggregator counts: ballotpedia_oct21 (statewide article; gives only LA and San Mateo by county), coleman_nov4_tax_rows (heuristic per-county count of rows in Coleman's tax-measure tables: tax measures only, approximate lower bound), and others (KQED/NBC) labelled as aggregator. Checks only, never sources of record.
schema.unverified: Claims in this entry that rest on aggregators, search snippets or inference rather than an official page read by us.
